SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_calc,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date < DATE '2024-09-01' AND f.vat_rate=0.255 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) early255,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AND f.vat_rate=0.24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late24
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH d AS (SELECT calendar_date, is_trading_day, holiday_name FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'),
f AS (SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN f.net_amount END) st_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' THEN 1 END) web_n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_net, count(*) rstores FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, f.n, f.stores, f.web_n, f.st_net, r.rpt_net, r.rstores, round(f.st_net - r.rpt_net,2) diff
FROM d LEFT JOIN f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE f.n IS NULL OR f.stores<>r.rstores OR abs(f.st_net-r.rpt_net)>1 OR d.is_trading_day=false OR f.stores<40 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.open_date, s.close_date, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days_with_sales, min(f.sale_date) first_sale, max(f.sale_date) last_sale,
 (SELECT string_agg(c.closure_type||' '||c.closure_start_date||'..'||c.closure_end_date, '; ') FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=s.store_id AND c.closure_end_date>=DATE '2024-08-01' AND c.closure_start_date<=DATE '2024-09-30') closures,
